message: —The day after the Martial Festival finals ended.

name: Iori
message: 「Haah...」
I let out a sigh as I headed toward Takamura Class's classroom.
Yesterday, I asked the company commander if there was any way I could keep going on this "errand."
The conclusion was that it was possible within the scope of the company commander's authority, though any orders from higher up would naturally override it.
In the end, no progress since the last time we talked.
The large-scale mission assigned to the company was apparently still ongoing, and they were short on manpower to boot.

name: Iori
message: 「...I really might have to go back after all.」
I had also considered taking the plunge and resigning from the Tenju Special Forces.
However, the people there had looked after me ever since I graduated from the academy up until today.
I couldn't just cut ties that easily.
...Walking along lost in those thoughts, I found myself right in front of Takamura Class's classroom.

name: Iori
message: 「No point brooding over it, huh.」
Right now I was a teacher, and there were students waiting for me here. I couldn't show them a gloomy face.

name: Iori
message: 「All right, let's do this！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Good morning, everyone！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sup, Iorin.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning.」
Ririmu and Asahi greeted me just like always.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mornin', Sensei!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sleepy...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Good morning.」
Setsugekka, Momiji, and Keisetsu were their usual selves too. I felt a small wave of relief.

name: Iori
message: 「You managed to wake up on time too, Momiji. Surprising you didn't oversleep after how tough that match was.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course she did—I was the one who woke her up, after all!」

name: Iori
message: 「You had a match too, Setsugekka, yet you're full of energy.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heheh, energy is my one redeeming quality, after all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, my body hurts...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahh, that's 'cause Secchan beat the crap outta you yesterday, right? Serves ya right！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehehe.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Honestly, you guys… what’s with finding joy in other people’s misfortune?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Everyone has their sights set on the Toujinegi’s head, after all. Momiji-san’s slump is a joy to everyone in the Martial Arts Division.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yup, yup. Asahi, you’re saying it like it is！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You’re quite welcome.」

name: Iori
message: 「She’s right. From now on, until next year’s Martial Festival, the students of the Martial Arts Division will make defeating Momiji their goal.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, don’t get cocky—keep working hard.」

name: Iori
message: 「For those of you who lost this time, it’s not the end yet.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re still first-years. You still have two more chances. You just need to keep training and get stronger from here on out.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Next year, I’m definitely going to be the Toujinegi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san, you’re scheduled to lose to me in the semifinals, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Like I’d lose to someone like you~!」
Even while bickering, the two of them look like they’re having fun.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, the first semester ends in a few days. The academy will be entering summer break.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’d like to hear about your plans for the summer vacation.」

name: Iori
message: 「Many students go back home to relax during the break, but quite a few stay at the academy to work on independent training.」

name: Iori
message: 「What are you all planning to do？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, ooh! I don’t want to go back home at all, so I’m planning on spending the summer at the academy!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin, let’s go on a date this summer break—a real date！」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, setting aside the ‘date’ part, I might be able to help you with practice. What about you, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s a hassle, but I’m going home once. I have to report about the Toujinegi to my father, you see.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, well, I suppose that’s expected.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And you’re coming with me then, Teacher, so I’ll need you to go over the details later~」

name: Iori
message: 「Me too？ How come？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You promised to play with Tsubaki, didn’t you? If I don’t bring you back with me, she’s going to wail her head off.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, that's right！ Okay, let's go together.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat, going back to visit her family together? Isn't that unfair?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, please come with me to my family's home as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Why's that？」

name: Asahi
message: 「My brother told me he'd been in touch with you, Iori-sensei. I thought it might be nice for you two to see each other again after so long.」

name: Iori
message: 「True, it has been a while—I'd definitely like to see Takahisa again.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then let's discuss the schedule later.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And while we're at it, let's also plan how we'll break the news of our marriage to my parents♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, we're not getting married！？」
The last thing I need is for her to turn this into a done deal behind my back.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, that just leaves Setsugekka and Keisetsu.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, well, about that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei—I've decided to leave the academy.」
The air in the classroom froze.
Setsugekka is leaving the academy...？

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh? W-What are you talking about, Secchan? That's not funny at all. You're joking, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sorry, Ririmu-chan. I thought a lot about it yesterday, and I've already made up my mind.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In the first place, Kei-chan and I only came to this academy to beat Suzakuin and become the Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Now that we couldn't win, there's no point in me staying here.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Challenge them again next year and win. Wouldn't that work？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan has a really important job waiting for her. She was personally chosen by the current head of Kazamine, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If she pulls this off, the position of next family head is practically guaranteed！ You just can't pass up a chance like that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's an overseas job, though, so there's no coming back for three years—or maybe even longer...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even if I could make it back, I don't think there'd be any point in re-enrolling three years from now or anything.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So I figured it'd feel better to just make a clean break and drop out right away~」
Three years from now—by then, everyone here would have already graduated from the academy.
Still, there was something that didn't sit right with me.

name: Iori
message: 「It's true I heard before that Keisetsu might end up going overseas.」

name: Iori
message: 「But weren't you supposed to stay in Japan, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That was just something Kei-chan decided on her own.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No matter what path Kei-chan chooses from here on out, I'm going with her.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I told Kei-chan that from the very beginning, and my feelings haven't changed.」
I glanced over at Keisetsu, and she raised both hands slightly. I suppose that meant she'd given up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The country Kei-chan is heading to is pretty dangerous, you know. Even this request only came up because her predecessor passed away.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「There's no way I can let Kei-chan go somewhere that dangerous all by herself.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I've always been the one getting helped by Kei-chan. Whenever I was in trouble, Kei-chan was always there to save me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wouldn't have even been able to enroll in this academy in the first place if it weren't for Kei-chan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So this time, it's my turn to repay Kei-chan. No matter what happens, I'm going to protect Kei-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because if anything were to happen to Kei-chan... I don't think I'd ever be able to recover.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's why I'm going with Kei-chan.」
Everyone fell silent at once.
Broadly speaking, this was a family matter. Poking my nose into it would be nothing short of tactless.
Even knowing that, I couldn't stop myself from speaking up.

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu... about this, can't you postpone going overseas until after you graduate...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's impossible.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The current head's request is to secure an on-site manager. If I can't go, someone else who can move immediately will go instead.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If that happens, I'll be throwing away my chance.」
I see... So there's no helping it, then...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, I'm sorry this is so sudden. Thank you for everything you've taught me.」

name: Iori
message: 「When are you planning to leave Japan？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I still don't know the details, but I think it'll be sometime during summer break.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So as soon as summer break starts, I'll begin the withdrawal paperwork, pack up my things, and move out of the dorm.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That means my summer plans are basically just relaxing at my parents' place until Kei-chan's job starts, I guess.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, once I drop out, summer break won't even matter anymore, ahahaha...」
Setsugekka scratched her head with a laugh.

name: Momiji
message: 「...What about Jindou？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？」

name: Momiji
message: 「What are you going to do about Jindou？ Are you going to keep at it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uh, well, I want to keep going, yeah, but they say Origami won't activate overseas... so I probably won't be able to.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, I can use Mishima-ryuu Martial Arts anywhere, so if any weirdos get near Kei-chan, I'll take 'em dooown!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So don't worry, it'll be fine.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not worried at all, and I couldn't care less.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-What's with that attitude...? Oh, wait—you're just going to be lonely without me around, aren't you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh, if Momimomi really insists, I suppose I could stay right here for you, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...You shouldn't say careless things like that, Setsugekka.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Right after talking so big about how you couldn't let Keisetsu go alone, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「How can you say something like that with the very same mouth? This is ridiculous—I'm done putting up with it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...W-What the heck, Momimomi, you big idiot! You could at least play along a little!」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, thank you. I'm completely sick of being dragged around by your goofy, flippant antics.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you're going to leave, then by all means, do as you please.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Oh, fine! Oh, is that how it is?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeees, yes, I get it, loud and clear！ I'll disappear just like you want, so see ya！！」
Setsugekka ran off somewhere.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji... That was out of line. You should apologize.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmph, I don't know.」
Momiji keeps her face turned away and says nothing.
For a moment, I thought about going after Setsugekka, but she's probably too worked up right now.
It'd be better to give it a little time before talking to her.
Besides, I couldn't just walk out and leave everyone else behind when they were all shocked about Setsugekka.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I still can't accept this, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, isn't it weird？ Does Secchan even have a reason to quit？ Keisetsu's the one becoming head of the family, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Keisetsu's Keisetsu, and Secchan's Secchan! They should each just do what they want!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Were you listening to what Setsugekka-san said？」

name: Asahi
message: 「What Setsugekka-san wants to do is follow Keisetsu-san and repay her debt of gratitude.」

name: Asahi
message: 「She made the decision to leave the academy so she could do what she wants. That is all there is to it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know that, I know, buuut—！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Are you really okay with that, Asahi? With Secchan just quitting like this?！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Because I have no reason to stop her.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes you do！ I don't want Secchan to leave, and everyone's gonna be lonely without her！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then do you mean to tell her, 'Please stay at the academy to ease our loneliness'？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「W-Well, that's... uuuugh...！」
Pressed by Asahi, Ririmu starts agonizing over it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait a second, Keisetsu, you've been quiet this whole time too. Do you really think this is okay？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Whether it's good or bad, she insisted on doing this herself and wouldn't listen, so there's nothing to be done.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I even prepared the option for Setsugekka to stay behind in Japan on her own. Yet she refused to choose that path.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What more would you have me do？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「O-Oh, I see. Then I guess it can't be helped...」
Ririmu wilts, looking completely dejected.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Besides... Setsugekka's choice makes me happy as well.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka and I are twins. Someone special to each other.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We are two as one, halves split from a single cell. A right hand and a left hand, making up for what the other lacks.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「For example, when you use both hands to accomplish one thing, would you ever think about which one is using the other?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Because Setsugekka wished for it, I pulled strings here and there to make it possible for her to attend this academy.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Because Setsugekka wished for it, I used a secret art to grant her power.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I don't want her to feel indebted to me in the slightest. To me, it's only natural.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Two as one—working together to accomplish one thing.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I act for Setsugekka's sake, and Setsugekka acts for mine. All this time, that's how the two of us have lived.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I doubt this is something you can understand. Even so, to us, this is simply normal.」
To those of us watching from the outside, Setsugekka and Keisetsu are two individuals with separate personalities.
But to the two of them, that's not how it is, huh...

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hmph. Must be nice, the two of you getting along so well.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I suppose this isn't a satisfying outcome for you, but aren't you directing your snide remarks at the wrong person？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I know. It's not Keisetsu's fault, and it's not Setsugekka's fault either. Neither of them did anything wrong at aaall. I know all of that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, I'm not feeling well, so I'll be leaving early.」
With those words, Momiji walked out of the classroom.
